# Clear the opposite attachment icon source attribute when switching formats

The current attachment-list setter uses src for ordinary/deleted/loading/cloud icons and srcset for generated moz-icon candidates. Each branch removes the other attribute. The direct icon test checks both the expected value and absence of the opposite attribute; it separately checks image completion and a nonzero natural width. These are current component/test contracts. The earlier twelve-file HiDPI backout is exact, but no failed test was reproduced and this later guard is not claimed to explain or fix that backout. No native image rendering ran.

Scope: Attachment list icon source state.
